scope_gate: Material changes require delta, affected_surfaces, invariants, out_of_scope, compatibility, regression_surface and rollback. Unmentioned elements remain unchanged.
design_system_gate: Before implementing an interface, inspect the component catalog and record reuse, extend, create, local or not_applicable with rationale and consumer surfaces.
model_routing: Use the least expensive capable model after risk classification, declare ceilings, and reuse fresh evidence only when observed dependencies are unchanged.
promotion_rule: Applicable scenarios require fresh passing evidence; an exception is scoped, compensating, authorized and expiring.
exposure_rule: Compare each exposure dimension independently. Above an approved limit, reduce RTO or affected fraction and preserve non-relaxable safety floors.
forbidden_inferences: budget alert is a hard stop
silence authorizes removal or behavior change
a nearby refactor is part of the requested delta
